messages.subject: RRO 3.2.1  vs. Opensuse 13.2
parts:
Hello ,
I liked what I find out about RRO and I tried to install RRO 3.2.1 on on a  OpenSuse 13.2 64bit on which R 3.2.1+ RStudio/rkward run without any problems .
The RRO installation has an issue .
t asks for libicu 51.2  whereas opensuse 13.2  has libicu installed at 53.1 .
With that issue RRO does not start . This the message produced :
/usr/lib64/RRO-3.2.1/R-3.2.1/lib64/R/bin/exec/R: error while loading shared libraries: libicuuc.so.51.2: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory

Please find below what it installed on Opensuse 13.2 .

zypper se -i libicu
S | Name              | Summary                                                  | Type
--+-------------------+----------------------------------------------------------+--------
i | libicu-devel      | International Components for Unicode (development files) | package
i | libicu53_1        | International Components for Unicode                     | package
i | libicu53_1-32bit  | International Components for Unicode                     | package
i | libicu53_1-ledata | Rule databases and tables for ICU                        | package

Question :
Is there any RRO-3.2.1 plan to support openSuSE 13.2 in future ?
If yes when it will be available/planned  ?

Thank you,
Nick
